title: Delivery 60 Seconds · parte 1/4: modulos compartidos + Behaviors
request: Primera parte de la instalacion de Delivery: 60 Seconds. Crea ReplicatedStorage.DeliveryShared con los cuatro modulos compartidos (Config con la configuracion global y la tabla Reputation, Packages con las 8 clases de paquete y su dificultad/MinRep, CityEvents con los 6 eventos de ciudad y Remotes con los RemoteEvent/RemoteFunction) y la carpeta ServerScriptService.DeliveryServer.Behaviors con los 7 comportamientos autocontenidos de entidades (Dog, Thief, Drone, Chicken, Anomaly, TrafficCar, Vehicle). Todo con ensure_instance + set_script_source, idempotente.

-- CONFIG · Delivery: 60 Seconds
-- Configuración global del juego. Ajusta estos valores a tu gusto.
--============================================================

	DeliveryTime = 60,            -- segundos por entrega (los paquetes pueden sobreescribirlo)
	TimeBonusPerSecond = 2,       -- $ extra por cada segundo restante
	AutoNextDelivery = true,      -- asignar la siguiente entrega automáticamente
	NextDeliveryDelay = 3,        -- segundos hasta la siguiente entrega automática

	-- ⭐ Progresión
	XPPerDelivery = 50,
	XPPerSecondLeft = 1,
	XPPerLevel = 500,
	StartMoney = 0,
	StartingVehicle = "Bike",     -- vehículo inicial gratuito

	BaseWalkSpeed = 16,

	StaminaMax = 100,
	StaminaDrain = 22,            -- por segundo corriendo
	StaminaRegen = 16,            -- por segundo en reposo

	HardHitVelocity = 45,         -- studs/s de la parte que golpea el paquete
	HardFallVelocity = 55,        -- velocidad vertical de caída que cuenta como golpe

--!nonstrict
--============================================================
-- PAQUETES · Delivery: 60 Seconds
-- Cada paquete cambia la partida.
--   Weight     = probabilidad relativa
--   Difficulty = ⭐ 1 normal · ⭐⭐ especial · ⭐⭐⭐ extrema
--   MinRep     = reputación mínima para que pueda salir en oferta
--============================================================
local Packages = {
	-- ⭐ Dificultad 1 (normales — desde reputación 0)
	{
		Id = "Normal", Icon = "📦", Name = "Normal",
		Weight = 30, Pay = 150, Time = 60, Difficulty = 1, MinRep = 0,
		Desc = "Sin penalización. Una entrega tranquila.",
	},
	{
		Id = "Heavy", Icon = "🐌", Name = "Pesado",
		Weight = 14, Pay = 170, Time = 60, Difficulty = 1, MinRep = 0,
		Desc = "Reduce tu velocidad y movilidad (-30%).",
	},
	{
		Id = "NoJump", Icon = "🦶", Name = "Sin salto",
		Weight = 10, Pay = 160, Time = 60, Difficulty = 1, MinRep = 0,
		Desc = "No puedes saltar durante la entrega.",
	},
	-- ⭐⭐ Dificultad 2 (especiales — requieren reputación 40+)
	{
		Id = "Public", Icon = "👀", Name = "Público",
		Weight = 12, Pay = 220, Time = 60, Difficulty = 2, MinRep = 40,
		Desc = "Todos pueden ver quién lleva el paquete. Los ladrones te buscan.",
	},
	{
		Id = "Fragile", Icon = "❤️", Name = "Frágil",
		Weight = 10, Pay = 240, Time = 60, Difficulty = 2, MinRep = 40,
		Desc = "El paquete tiene resistencia limitada y puede romperse.",
	},
	{
		Id = "Chicken", Icon = "🐔", Name = "Chicken Package",
		Weight = 8, Pay = 230, Time = 60, Difficulty = 2, MinRep = 40,
		Desc = "El paquete contiene un pollo que puede escapar. ¡Atrápalo!",
	},
	-- ⭐⭐⭐ Dificultad 3 (extremos — requieren reputación 70+)
	{
		Id = "Explosive", Icon = "💣", Name = "Explosivo",
		Weight = 8, Pay = 300, Time = 60, Difficulty = 3, MinRep = 70,
		Desc = "¡Los golpes fuertes pueden hacerlo explotar!",
	},
	{
		Id = "Valuable", Icon = "💰", Name = "Valioso",
		Weight = 5, Pay = 420, Time = 45, Difficulty = 3, MinRep = 70,
		Desc = "Paga muchísimo más… pero solo tienes 45 segundos.",
	},
}

-- Selección ponderada aleatoria (todos los paquetes)
function Packages.Pick(rng)
	local total = 0
	for _, p in ipairs(Packages) do
		total += p.Weight
	end
	local roll = rng:NextNumber(0, total)
	for _, p in ipairs(Packages) do
		roll -= p.Weight
		if roll <= 0 then
			return p
		end
	end
	return Packages[1]
end

-- Selección ponderada FILTRADA por reputación:
-- a mayor reputación, mejores ofertas de envío (y más dinero)
function Packages.PickForRep(rng, rep)
	local pool = {}
	local total = 0
	for _, p in ipairs(Packages) do
		if rep >= (p.MinRep or 0) then
			table.insert(pool, p)
			total += p.Weight
		end
	end
	if total <= 0 then
		return Packages[1]
	end
	local roll = rng:NextNumber(0, total)
	for _, p in ipairs(pool) do
		roll -= p.Weight
		if roll <= 0 then
			return p
		end
	end
	return pool[#pool]
end

return Packages

--!nonstrict
--============================================================
-- REMOTES · Delivery: 60 Seconds
-- Crea (servidor) o espera (cliente) los RemoteEvents/Functions.
--============================================================
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local DEFS = {
	-- servidor → cliente
	DeliveryPopup = "RemoteEvent",   -- tarjetas: entrega asignada / éxito / fallo / aviso
	EventAnnounce = "RemoteEvent",   -- banner de evento de ciudad (a todos)
	OpenShop = "RemoteEvent",        -- abrir la tienda de mejoras
	-- cliente → servidor
	Sprint = "RemoteEvent",          -- bool: correr
	PurchaseUpgrade = "RemoteFunction",
	PurchaseVehicle = "RemoteFunction",
	SpawnVehicle = "RemoteFunction",
	GetState = "RemoteFunction",     -- datos para la tienda
}

local Remotes = {}

if RunService:IsServer() then
	local folder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("DeliveryRemotes")
	if not folder then
		folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = "DeliveryRemotes"
		folder.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	end
	for name, className in DEFS do
		local r = folder:FindFirstChild(name)
		if not r then
			r = Instance.new(className)
			r.Name = name
			r.Parent = folder
		end
		Remotes[name] = r
	end
else
	local folder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("DeliveryRemotes")
	for name in DEFS do
		Remotes[name] = folder:WaitForChild(name)
	end
end

return Remotes

--!nonstrict
--============================================================
-- 👻 ANOMALY (comportamiento autocontenido)
-- Persigue al repartidor activo más cercano (lee el atributo
-- DeliveryState de cada jugador). Al alcanzarlo, lo notifica,
-- retrocede y sigue acechando hasta que acaba LifeTime.
--
-- Atributos de ENTRADA: Speed · CatchDist · LifeTime
-- Atributos de SALIDA: CaughtUserId + CaughtTick (por cada golpe)
--============================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local PlaceholderBuilder = require(script.Parent.Parent.PlaceholderBuilder)

local Anomaly = {}

local function rootPos(player)
	local char = player and player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	return hrp and hrp.Position or nil
end

function Anomaly.Run(model)
	if model:GetAttribute("BehaviorRunning") then return end
	model:SetAttribute("BehaviorRunning", true)

	if not model.PrimaryPart then
		if model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) then
			PlaceholderBuilder.EnsurePrimary(model)
		else
			PlaceholderBuilder.Build("Anomaly", model)
		end
	end
	local root = model.PrimaryPart
	if not root then model:Destroy() return end

	local speed = model:GetAttribute("Speed") or 24
	local catchDist = model:GetAttribute("CatchDist") or 4.5
	local life = model:GetAttribute("LifeTime") or 30

	local t0 = os.clock()
	while model.Parent do
		local dt = task.wait()
		if os.clock() - t0 > life then break end

		-- repartidor activo más cercano
		local bestPlayer, bestDist
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local state = player:GetAttribute("DeliveryState")
			if state and state ~= "None" then
				local pos = rootPos(player)
				if pos then
					local d = (pos - root.Position).Magnitude
					if not bestDist or d < bestDist then
						bestDist = d
						bestPlayer = player
					end
				end
			end
		end

		local target = bestPlayer and rootPos(bestPlayer)
		if target then
			local pos = root.Position
			local goal = Vector3.new(target.X, pos.Y, target.Z)
			local delta = goal - pos
			local d = delta.Magnitude
			if d < catchDist then
				-- golpe: notifica y retrocede
				model:SetAttribute("CaughtUserId", bestPlayer.UserId)
				model:SetAttribute("CaughtTick", os.clock())
				model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pos - delta.Unit * 10))
			else
				local newPos = pos + delta.Unit * math.min(speed * dt, d)
				model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(newPos, goal))
			end
		end
	end

	if model.Parent then
		model:Destroy()
	end
end

return Anomaly

--!nonstrict
--============================================================
-- 🐔 CHICKEN (comportamiento autocontenido)
-- El pollo escapado: salta por los alrededores hasta que su dueño
-- lo atrapa con el ProximityPrompt "Atrapar pollo".
--
-- Atributos de ENTRADA: TargetUserId · LifeTime (s)
-- Atributos de SALIDA: CaughtUserId + CaughtTick
--============================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local PlaceholderBuilder = require(script.Parent.Parent.PlaceholderBuilder)

local Chicken = {}

local rng = Random.new()

function Chicken.Run(model)
	if model:GetAttribute("BehaviorRunning") then return end
	model:SetAttribute("BehaviorRunning", true)

	if not model.PrimaryPart then
		if model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) then
			PlaceholderBuilder.EnsurePrimary(model)
		else
			PlaceholderBuilder.Build("Chicken", model)
		end
	end
	local root = model.PrimaryPart
	if not root then model:Destroy() return end

	local userId = model:GetAttribute("TargetUserId")
	local waited = os.clock()
	while not userId and os.clock() - waited < 5 do
		task.wait()
		userId = model:GetAttribute("TargetUserId")
	end
	if not userId then model:Destroy() return end

	local life = model:GetAttribute("LifeTime") or 40

	-- prompt para atraparlo (solo el dueño)
	local prompt = root:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt")
	if not prompt then
		prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
		prompt.ActionText = "Atrapar pollo"
		prompt.ObjectText = "🐔 Pollo escapado"
		prompt.HoldDuration = 0.1
		prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 10
		prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
		prompt.Parent = root
	end
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(p)
		if p.UserId ~= userId then return end
		if model:GetAttribute("CaughtTick") then return end
		model:SetAttribute("CaughtUserId", p.UserId)
		model:SetAttribute("CaughtTick", os.clock())
	end)

	-- saltos aleatorios cerca del punto de escape
	local home = root.Position
	local nextHop = 0
	local hopTarget = home
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while model.Parent do
		local dt = task.wait()
		if model:GetAttribute("CaughtTick") then break end
		if os.clock() - t0 > life then break end
		if os.clock() >= nextHop then
			nextHop = os.clock() + 0.8
			local angle = rng:NextNumber(0, math.pi * 2)
			local dist = rng:NextNumber(4, 20)
			hopTarget = home + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * dist, 0, math.sin(angle) * dist)
		end
		local pos = root.Position
		local goal = Vector3.new(hopTarget.X, home.Y, hopTarget.Z)
		local delta = goal - pos
		local d = delta.Magnitude
		if d > 1 then
			local hop = math.abs(math.sin(os.clock() * 6)) * 4
			local newPos = pos + delta.Unit * math.min(10 * dt, d) + Vector3.new(0, hop * dt, 0)
			model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(newPos, goal))
		end
	end

	task.wait(0.2)
	if model.Parent then
		model:Destroy()
	end
end

return Chicken

--!nonstrict
--============================================================
-- 🐕 DOG (comportamiento autocontenido)
-- Persigue al jugador objetivo; al alcanzarlo lo notifica por atributos.
--
-- Atributos de ENTRADA (modelo):
--   TargetUserId (number) · Speed (studs/s) · CatchDist · LifeTime (s)
-- Atributos de SALIDA:
--   CaughtUserId (number) + CaughtTick (os.clock)
-- Si el modelo está vacío, se construyen bloques placeholder.
--============================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local PlaceholderBuilder = require(script.Parent.Parent.PlaceholderBuilder)

local Dog = {}

local function rootPos(player)
	local char = player and player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	return hrp and hrp.Position or nil
end

function Dog.Run(model)
	if model:GetAttribute("BehaviorRunning") then return end
	model:SetAttribute("BehaviorRunning", true)

	if not model.PrimaryPart then
		if model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) then
			PlaceholderBuilder.EnsurePrimary(model)
		else
			PlaceholderBuilder.Build("Dog", model)
		end
	end
	local root = model.PrimaryPart
	if not root then model:Destroy() return end

	-- esperar el objetivo (el spawner lo fija antes de parentar)
	local userId = model:GetAttribute("TargetUserId")
	local waited = os.clock()
	while not userId and os.clock() - waited < 5 do
		task.wait()
		userId = model:GetAttribute("TargetUserId")
	end
	local player = userId and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
	if not player then model:Destroy() return end

	local speed = model:GetAttribute("Speed") or 22
	local catchDist = model:GetAttribute("CatchDist") or 3.5
	local life = model:GetAttribute("LifeTime") or 18

	local t0 = os.clock()
	local caught = false
	while model.Parent do
		local dt = task.wait()
		if os.clock() - t0 > life then break end
		local target = rootPos(player)
		if target then
			local pos = root.Position
			local goal = Vector3.new(target.X, pos.Y, target.Z)
			local delta = goal - pos
			local d = delta.Magnitude
			if d < catchDist then
				caught = true
				break
			end
			local step = math.min(speed * dt, d)
			local newPos = pos + delta.Unit * step
			model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(newPos, goal))
		end
	end

	if caught and model.Parent then
		model:SetAttribute("CaughtUserId", player.UserId)
		model:SetAttribute("CaughtTick", os.clock())
		task.wait(0.2)
	end
	if model.Parent then
		model:Destroy()
	end
end

return Dog

--!nonstrict
--============================================================
-- 🚁 DRONE (comportamiento autocontenido)
-- Sobrevuela al objetivo 3 s y luego baja en picado para hacerle
-- soltar el paquete.
--
-- Atributos de ENTRADA: TargetUserId · Speed · CatchDist · LifeTime
-- Atributos de SALIDA: CaughtUserId + CaughtTick
--============================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local PlaceholderBuilder = require(script.Parent.Parent.PlaceholderBuilder)

local Drone = {}

local function rootPos(player)
	local char = player and player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	return hrp and hrp.Position or nil
end

function Drone.Run(model)
	if model:GetAttribute("BehaviorRunning") then return end
	model:SetAttribute("BehaviorRunning", true)

	if not model.PrimaryPart then
		if model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) then
			PlaceholderBuilder.EnsurePrimary(model)
		else
			PlaceholderBuilder.Build("Drone", model)
		end
	end
	local root = model.PrimaryPart
	if not root then model:Destroy() return end

	local userId = model:GetAttribute("TargetUserId")
	local waited = os.clock()
	while not userId and os.clock() - waited < 5 do
		task.wait()
		userId = model:GetAttribute("TargetUserId")
	end
	local player = userId and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
	if not player then model:Destroy() return end

	local speed = model:GetAttribute("Speed") or 30
	local catchDist = model:GetAttribute("CatchDist") or 4
	local life = model:GetAttribute("LifeTime") or 12

	local t0 = os.clock()
	local caught = false
	while model.Parent do
		local dt = task.wait()
		local elapsed = os.clock() - t0
		if elapsed > life then break end
		local target = rootPos(player)
		if target then
			-- 3 s de vigilancia desde arriba, luego picado
			local goal = target + (elapsed < 3 and Vector3.new(0, 10, 0) or Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0))
			local pos = root.Position
			local delta = goal - pos
			local d = delta.Magnitude
			if elapsed >= 3 and d < catchDist then
				caught = true
				break
			end
			local newPos = pos + delta.Unit * math.min(speed * dt, d)
			model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(newPos))
		end
	end

	if caught and model.Parent then
		model:SetAttribute("CaughtUserId", player.UserId)
		model:SetAttribute("CaughtTick", os.clock())
		task.wait(0.2)
	end
	if model.Parent then
		model:Destroy()
	end
end

return Drone

			end
			local newPos = pos + delta.Unit * math.min(speed * dt, d)
			model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(newPos, goal))
		end
	end

	if caught and model.Parent then
		model:SetAttribute("CaughtUserId", player.UserId)
		model:SetAttribute("CaughtTick", os.clock())
		task.wait(0.2)
	end
	if model.Parent then
		model:Destroy()
	end
end

return Thief

--!nonstrict
--============================================================
-- 🚗 TRAFFIC CAR (comportamiento autocontenido)
-- Va y viene entre dos puntos (evento Caos de tráfico).
-- Al tocar a un jugador lo notifica (con anti-spam por jugador).
--
-- Atributos de ENTRADA:
--   WaypointA / WaypointB (Vector3) · Speed · LifeTime (s)
-- Atributos de SALIDA: CaughtUserId + CaughtTick (por cada golpe)
--============================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local PlaceholderBuilder = require(script.Parent.Parent.PlaceholderBuilder)

local TrafficCar = {}

local rng = Random.new()

function TrafficCar.Run(model)
	if model:GetAttribute("BehaviorRunning") then return end
	model:SetAttribute("BehaviorRunning", true)

	if not model.PrimaryPart then
		if model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) then
			PlaceholderBuilder.EnsurePrimary(model)
		else
			PlaceholderBuilder.Build("TrafficCar", model)
		end
	end
	local root = model.PrimaryPart
	if not root then model:Destroy() return end

	local a = model:GetAttribute("WaypointA")
	local b = model:GetAttribute("WaypointB")
	if typeof(a) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(b) ~= "Vector3" then
		model:Destroy()
		return
	end
	local speed = model:GetAttribute("Speed") or 32
	local life = model:GetAttribute("LifeTime") or 40

	-- golpear al tocar (anti-spam 1.2 s por jugador)
	local lastHit = {}
	for _, part in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
				local hum = hit.Parent and hit.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				local plr = hum and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
				if plr then
					local now = os.clock()
					if not lastHit[plr.UserId] or now - lastHit[plr.UserId] > 1.2 then
						lastHit[plr.UserId] = now
						model:SetAttribute("CaughtUserId", plr.UserId)
						model:SetAttribute("CaughtTick", now)
					end
				end
			end)
		end
	end

	-- ida y vuelta entre A y B
	local t = rng:NextNumber()
	local dir = 1
	local length = (b - a).Magnitude
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while model.Parent do
		local dt = task.wait()
		if os.clock() - t0 > life then break end
		t += dir * dt * (speed / math.max(length, 1))
		if t >= 1 then t = 1 dir = -1 end
		if t <= 0 then t = 0 dir = 1 end
		local pos = a:Lerp(b, t)
		local face = (b - a).Unit * dir
		model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + face))
	end

	if model.Parent then
		model:Destroy()
	end
end

return TrafficCar

--!nonstrict
--============================================================
-- 🚲 VEHICLE (comportamiento autocontenido · sirve para Bike,
-- Scooter, Moto y Car; la configuración llega por atributos)
--
-- Prepara CUALQUIER modelo para conducirse:
--   · si está vacío → bloques placeholder (con VehicleSeat)
--   · si tu modelo no trae VehicleSeat → crea uno soldado encima
--   · suelta (desancla) todas las partes y las suelda al PrimaryPart
--   · aplica MaxSpeed/Torque/TurnSpeed y asigna el dueño de red
--
-- Atributos de ENTRADA: MaxSpeed · Torque · TurnSpeed · OwnerUserId
--============================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local PlaceholderBuilder = require(script.Parent.Parent.PlaceholderBuilder)

local Vehicle = {}

function Vehicle.Run(model)
	if model:GetAttribute("BehaviorRunning") then return end
	model:SetAttribute("BehaviorRunning", true)

	-- placeholder si está vacío (según el NOMBRE del modelo: Bike/Scooter/Moto/Car)
	if not model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) then
		PlaceholderBuilder.Build(model.Name, model)
	end
	PlaceholderBuilder.EnsurePrimary(model)
	local root = model.PrimaryPart
	if not root then model:Destroy() return end

	-- asiento de conducción
	local seat = model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("VehicleSeat", true)
	if not seat then
		seat = Instance.new("VehicleSeat")
		seat.Name = "DriveSeat"
		seat.Size = Vector3.new(2, 1, 2)
		seat.Color = Color3.fromRGB(38, 40, 46)
		seat.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		local extents = model:GetExtentsSize()
		seat.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, extents.Y / 2 + 0.6, 0)
		seat.Parent = model
	end
	seat.MaxSpeed = model:GetAttribute("MaxSpeed") or 32
	seat.Torque = model:GetAttribute("Torque") or 2
	seat.TurnSpeed = model:GetAttribute("TurnSpeed") or 2.5
	seat.Disabled = false

	-- soldar todo rígido al PrimaryPart y desanclar
	for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			d.Anchored = false
			if d ~= root then
				local has = false
				for _, w in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
					if w:IsA("WeldConstraint") and w.Part1 == d then
						has = true
						break
					end
				end
				if not has then
					local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
					w.Part0 = root
					w.Part1 = d
					w.Parent = root
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- dueño de red para conducción fluida
	local ownerId = model:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId")
	local owner = ownerId and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(ownerId)
	if owner then
		pcall(function()
			root:SetNetworkOwner(owner)
		end)
	end
end

return Vehicle
